does: Registers the interface parts of a set of modules (each module's GUI folder: metadata, assets, state machines, resources) as ModData of the interface's mod manager; answers whether it registered anything. On the first start it runs once, at the end of LoadModule, with the module manager's load-ordered modules (16 in copy attacks), returning true.

evidence.says: the dx11 binary's own name for it, with its signature (ObjectSet<ls::Module> const&)
a probe in copy attacks (t3): one call per first start, row before LoadModule->LoadMenu, set size 16, answer 1
NoesisGUIBinding.dll exports this name; the symbol database matches the export to this function by strings

called by the fork's early merge on the interface's first update after the first StartLoading with 4 modules taken from Settings.Mods and AvailableMods (copy attacks, f7): answered true, 9 ms after StartLoading and 17 ms before the Loading state was entered; the game's own call followed at the end of LoadModule with 16
a count probe in copy coord: 0 calls in a save's load from the menu and in a return to the menu; 1 call in a save's load after a mod was toggled in the mod manager (the client's LoadModule ran again)

a probe with a snapshot of its second argument at the first start's own merge (end of LoadModule): the array is the client's LoadOrderedModules, 16 modules, the same UUIDs in the same order as the set the fork merged early at StartLoading

a probe in copy coord (c2, build v34-start-extmod-3): 0 calls in the main menu through six Ext.Mod.SetEnabled toggles; one call in the next load, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1210301, the head of code:gui::GameUI::UpdateFromUI's mods' merge block, followed there by 11 calls of code:ui::TextureProvider::LoadTextureMetadataInternal (so it answered true)
